notes.title: WELCOME TO MOTHERSHIP
notes.notes:
Hi explorers !

This is my very first announcement on Steam ! So excited ! 

First of all: Hi ! I’m Carlos, the solo dev behind Mothership and I welcome you all to the MOTHERSHIP Community ! 

I have a big news to announce you: Mothership has received the Epic MegaGrant !!!!!! MegaGrants are offered by Epic Games to support innovative projects built in Unreal Engine. And because I am a solo dev this is a total game-changer. Now, I will be able to make the game of my dreams, without constraints. 
In order to celebrate such great news I have updated the Steam page with the current in-progress visuals and information of the game and I have made the first dev trailer. You can see the new trailer on the steam page and on youtube: 

[previewyoutube=L4VKLMrRqdw;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=L4VKLMrRqdw
[/previewyoutube]

I will keep you updated :)

Peace,
Carlos
